variables.name: ServerName

0.title: Servers monitored
0.query:
timeseries u=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.systemuptime`), by:{device.name}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| summarize Servers = count()

1.title: Servers not responding (last 24h seen)
1.query:
timeseries n=count(`snmp.winserver.hr.systemuptime`), by:{device.name}, from:now()-24h, interval:5m, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| summarize `Not responding` = countIf(isNull(arrayLast(n)))

2.title: Servers with CPU >= 95%

3.title: Servers with memory >= 95%

4.title: Disks >= 85% used
4.query:
timeseries { size=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storagesize`), used=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storageused`) }, by:{device.name, storage.descr, storage.allocationunits}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| filter substring(storage.descr, from: 1, to: 2) == ":" and arrayLast(size) > 0
| fieldsAdd Disk = substring(storage.descr, from: 0, to: 3), alloc = toDouble(storage.allocationunits)
| fieldsAdd p = arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(size) * 100
| summarize `Disks >= 85%` = countIf(p >= 85)

5.title: Stopped services (seen in last 24h)
5.query:
timeseries st=avg(`snmp.winserver.svc.operatingstate`), by:{device.name, svc.name}, from:now()-24h, interval:5m, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| summarize `Stopped services` = countIf(isNull(arrayLast(st)))

6.title: Server overview

7.title: CPU used % by server (now)
7.query:
timeseries load=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.processorload`), by:{device.name}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| fieldsAdd `CPU used %` = arrayLast(load), Server = arrayFirst(splitString(device.name, "."))
| fields Server, `CPU used %`
| sort `CPU used %` desc

8.title: CPU used % over time by server

9.title: Memory used % by server (now)
9.query:
timeseries { size=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storagesize`), used=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storageused`) }, by:{device.name, storage.allocationunits}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName)) AND contains(storage.descr, "Physical Memory")}
| fieldsAdd `Memory used %` = arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(size) * 100, Server = arrayFirst(splitString(device.name, "."))
| fields Server, `Memory used %`
| sort `Memory used %` desc

10.title: Memory used % over time by server

11.title: Disks - all servers (fullest first)
11.query:
timeseries { size=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storagesize`), used=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storageused`) }, by:{device.name, storage.descr, storage.allocationunits}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| filter substring(storage.descr, from: 1, to: 2) == ":" and arrayLast(size) > 0
| fieldsAdd Disk = substring(storage.descr, from: 0, to: 3), alloc = toDouble(storage.allocationunits)
| fieldsAdd `Space total GiB` = arrayLast(size) * alloc / 1073741824, `Space available GiB` = (arrayLast(size) - arrayLast(used)) * alloc / 1073741824, `Space used GiB` = arrayLast(used) * alloc / 1073741824, `Usage %` = arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(size) * 100
| fields device.name, Disk, `Space total GiB`, `Space available GiB`, `Space used GiB`, `Usage %`
| sort `Usage %` desc

12.title: Disk usage % - fullest 20 disks
12.query:
timeseries { size=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storagesize`), used=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storageused`) }, by:{device.name, storage.descr, storage.allocationunits}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| filter substring(storage.descr, from: 1, to: 2) == ":" and arrayLast(size) > 0
| fieldsAdd Disk = substring(storage.descr, from: 0, to: 3), alloc = toDouble(storage.allocationunits)
| fieldsAdd `Usage %` = arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(size) * 100, Server = arrayFirst(splitString(device.name, "."))
| fieldsAdd `Server / Disk` = concat(Server, " ", Disk)
| fields `Server / Disk`, `Usage %`
| sort `Usage %` desc
| limit 20

13.title: Disk growth - used GiB per disk (last 7 days)
13.query:
timeseries { size=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storagesize`), used=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storageused`) }, from:now()-7d, interval:1h, by:{device.name, storage.descr, storage.allocationunits}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| filter substring(storage.descr, from: 1, to: 2) == ":" and arrayLast(size) > 0
| fieldsAdd Disk = substring(storage.descr, from: 0, to: 3), alloc = toDouble(storage.allocationunits)
| fieldsAdd `Used GiB` = used[] * alloc / 1073741824
| fields timeframe, interval, device.name, Disk, `Used GiB`

14.title: Disk growth summary (last 7 days, fastest first)
14.query:
timeseries { size=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storagesize`), used=avg(`snmp.winserver.hr.storageused`) }, from:now()-7d, interval:1h, by:{device.name, storage.descr, storage.allocationunits}, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| filter substring(storage.descr, from: 1, to: 2) == ":" and arrayLast(size) > 0
| fieldsAdd Disk = substring(storage.descr, from: 0, to: 3), alloc = toDouble(storage.allocationunits)
| fieldsAdd u = arrayRemoveNulls(used)
| fieldsAdd `Start GiB` = arrayFirst(u) * alloc / 1073741824, `Now GiB` = arrayLast(u) * alloc / 1073741824, `Days of data` = toDouble(arraySize(u)) / 24
| fieldsAdd `Change GiB` = `Now GiB` - `Start GiB`
| fieldsAdd `Growth GiB/day` = if(`Days of data` > 0, `Change GiB` / `Days of data`, else: 0)
| fields device.name, Disk, `Start GiB`, `Now GiB`, `Change GiB`, `Days of data`, `Growth GiB/day`
| sort `Growth GiB/day` desc

15.title: Network traffic by server (Mbit/s received)

16.title: Interface errors & discards by server (sum, last 2h)

17.title: Running services per server

18.title: Stopped services - all servers (reported in last 24h, not now)
18.query:
timeseries st=avg(`snmp.winserver.svc.operatingstate`), by:{device.name, svc.name}, from:now()-24h, interval:5m, filter:{in(device.name, array($ServerName))}
| filter isNull(arrayLast(st))
| fields device.name, svc.name
| sort device.name asc, svc.name asc
